name: Hermes
summary: Add a Diffusion provider with the chat-completions transport.
statusNote: Hermes's `hermes config set` rewrites YAML and drops comments; edit the file by hand instead. Generate examples from the live catalog, not static examples.
prerequisites: A Diffusion Router API key from API keys.

setup.title: Merge the Diffusion provider by hand
setup.body: Edit the YAML directly to preserve comments; do not use hermes config set.

code.text:
providers:
  diffusion:
    api:
      base_url: "https://router.diffusion.io/v1"
    key_env: "DIFFUSION_API_KEY"
    transport: "chat_completions"

setup.title: Export your Diffusion key
setup.body: Add the export to your shell profile and open a new terminal.

restart: Start a new Hermes session so the merged configuration is read.

verification.title: Select the Diffusion model
verification.body: Choose the custom provider model; --global persists the selection.

troubleshooting: 401/403: check the key and tenant binding in API keys.
Provider unknown: confirm the YAML indentation merged cleanly and Hermes was restarted.
Comments lost: you used hermes config set — restore your backup and edit by hand.

removal.title: Remove the Diffusion provider
removal.body: Delete the providers.diffusion block by hand and unset the key. Revoke the key in API keys if unused.

rollback: Run `hermes model` to reselect your previous default.
